feature_candidates.trace_structured: criterion-only TRACE-PMAG graph, component-aware target attribution, and evidence-chain features
feature_candidates.trace_monotonic_criterion: fixed monotonic method/carrier/bridge completeness score with no fitted threshold
feature_candidates.trace_target_context_word: word TF-IDF fitted inside each training fold on target-bound original-paper evidence contexts
feature_candidates.trace_target_context_char: character TF-IDF fitted inside each training fold on target-bound original-paper evidence contexts
feature_candidates.trace_structured_plus_target_context: late fusion of structured TRACE and the two fold-local target-context text models
feature_candidates.trace_joint_pairwise: within-paper positive-versus-negative target ranking with a label-free target-count gate

fixed_model_family: predeclared linear and monotonic models evaluated with complete-REFNO isolation
selection_rule: select any fitted candidate and fusion weight only inside outer training folds; never from outer-fold metrics
